calculation.description: Reverses the causal 10-session return after volatility normalization, with a bounded amplification when recent 5-session normalized trading range expands relative to its 40-session baseline. Uses only data available through the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC is negative in 2023-11-13 to 2025-12-31 (-0.072737, 155 dates), then positive in 2026-2028 (+0.051868, 634), 2029-2031 (+0.071619, 783), and 2032-2035-08-29 (+0.051249, 955). Interpret early-regime instability conservatively; later regimes are consistently positive. 15 tradable cross-asset instruments used, with at least 8 valid names per IC date.
